messages:
Alice Chen: Quick heads up — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/789 to update the model card GPU-fallback section for ZephyrX variants. Need a docs sanity check and one example that shows the CLI fallback behavior.

Marco Li: :eyes: On it. Is this only about GPU->CPU fallback or also the quantized CPU path?

Alice Chen: Both. The current card mentions CPU fallback, but doesn't show the `--quant-profile` label or the sample `rdwctl serve --fallback` output. I added a draft snippet but want someone who knows runtime to confirm wording.

Samira Patel: I can validate the snippet on Dedicated today. Which ZephyrX variant did you test?

Alice Chen: ZephyrX-7B-quant and ZephyrX-7B-int8 (local bench on rdx-dev1). The PR includes this snippet:

```
# start a local fallback server for ZephyrX
rdwctl serve --model zephyrx-7b-int8 --fallback cpu --quant-profile lite
# if GPU not available it will route to the fastest compatible CPU path
```

Marco Li: Small wording suggestion: replace "it will route" with "requests will fall back". Also add expected logs sample so users can see the switch: `FallbackExecutor: no GPU found, using cpu-quant-path (lite)`

Ivan Gomez: Also include the perf delta: on rdx-dev1, GPU latency 90ms->cpu-quant 320ms median for short prompts; costs differ ~3x. Don't guarantee numbers, mark them as examples and include the bench commit link.

Priya Rao: For the CLI sample we should show the compatibility check output before starting, e.g.:

```
$ rdwctl inspect-model zephyrx-7b-int8
compatible_hardware: gpu, cpu-quant-lite
recommended: gpu
```

That prevents surprise when someone only reads the serve example.

Alice Chen: Great. I'll add both the inspect output and Ivan's perf example with a clear "example results" note. Marco — can you add the log line in the runtime section? I don't want to claim exact wording if runtime team changes it.

Marco Li: Yep, I'll add a short note: "Log lines may vary by runtime version; e.g. `FallbackExecutor: no GPU found, using cpu-quant-path (lite)`". I'll also fix a broken relative link in the PR to `docs/quant-profiles.md` that pointed to the old path.

docs-bot: PR 789 assigned to reviewers: @Marco Li, @Samira Patel. Check suite: docs-lint, linkcheck.

Samira Patel: Running the snippet now. Quick note: on Dedicated test pool `dedi-test-3` the inspect output included `cpu-quant-lite` but the fallback log shows `cpu-quant-default` — looks like a naming mismatch between quant-profile alias and runtime. Pushing a small runtime note to the PR.

Alice Chen: Thanks. I'll update the card to call them "cpu-quant profiles (e.g., lite, default)" and add an inline callout to watch the log name. After Marco and Samira approve I'll squash and merge. :thumbsup:

Priya Rao: If no blockers I can run a short notebook example against the new card once merged to sanity-check the SDK snippet that references `rdw.client.fallback_policy`.

Ivan Gomez: Thanks all — filing a tiny follow-up issue to standardize naming across docs/runtime: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/432

Alice Chen: Lovely. Leaving the PR open for Marco/Samira review. I'll update the examples and push one more commit shortly.
